name: Moonberry Market
description: A lively row of weekly stalls under patchwork awnings along Mossy Hollow's gathering green.

visual.lighting: Colorful open shade under awnings; faint moonberry glow only at dusk.
visual.scale_notes: Counters have two heights; the cart lane is broad enough for a Sasquatch handcart.

layout_rules: The moonberry stall is at the uphill end of the awning row.
Mara's bakery counter is the middle stall facing the gathering green.
The cart lane slopes gently toward the root bridge, creating clear screen direction for rolling-object stories.
continuity_locks: Ripe moonberries are purple-blue and only faintly luminous near dusk.
Overripe moonberries bounce but are not magical, alive, or speaking.
All vendors and shoppers follow the global barefoot rule.
